title: Learning the Ropes
start: Talk to the Quest Guide on Tutorial Island.

steps.t: Players start by customising their character's appearance, such as hairstyles, skin colour, and clothing. All of these customisation options can later be altered through the Makeover Mage, the Appearance interface, and Thessalia's Makeovers after leaving Tutorial Island.
When the players click the "Done" button after customising the appearance, they need to choose a name.

The players can also choose their game mode: standard mode, Ironman Mode, Hardcore Ironman Mode, and Group Ironman Mode, which can still change to advanced game mode after finishing this step if they arrive on Tutorial Island.

After the player chooses a name, finishes customisation, and clicks the "Done" button, they are asked about their experience with RuneScape. Selecting the "Experienced" option will skip Tutorial Island automatically.

She tells the player to chop a tree until they get some logs in the backpack. She then tells the players to light the logs in the backpack to make a fire. Finally, she tells the players to catch some raw shrimps and cook them on the fire.

Players are expected to perform each of these actions at least one time, but if they wish, they can repeat until their Woodcutting, Firemaking, Fishing, and Cooking skills all reach level 3. No experience is gained for most actions on Tutorial Island after level 3 is reached. Players gain experience in Woodcutting, Firemaking, and Fishing faster on Tutorial Island than on the mainland, so this can be beneficial.

He hands the player the required items: a pot of flour and a bucket. The bucket must be filled with water from the sink. The flour and bucket of water must then be mixed to make bread dough, which is done by using one of the two items on the other. The dough can then be baked into bread at the cooking range by using the dough on the range.

When players have mined two copper ores and two tin ores, they can use the furnace to smelt the ores, combining them into two bronze bars. The Mining instructor then tells the player to smith the bars into a bronze dagger. Optionally deposit the bars in the metal bank via the forge and then start smithing on an anvil.

The Tutorial Island mine is one of the best areas to train these skills due to the rocks' proximity to the furnace and the anvil, so taking the opportunity to progress to level 3 here is worthwhile. Also consider smithing crush weapons such as a bronze mace and bronze off hand mace for the next area.

Players cannot die here, so food is not required. This makes it a good opportunity to further train Attack, Strength, Defence, and Constitution to level 3, 5, or beyond. The rats are weak to crush weapons. The rats do not respawn automatically; instead, the player must either log out and back in, hop worlds, or climb up and back down the ladder to reset them. The area is multi-combat, so multiple rats can be attacked at once.
Pures should pay attention, as the settings to disable certain kinds of combat experience are not available on Tutorial Island, so experience will be gained in all four melee skills.

He teaches players to access the bank, where they can store their possessions. The players then access the bank via a bank booth or banker. Unlike most bankers, the players cannot 'talk to' the banker on Tutorial Island. Generally, both cash and items can be withdrawn from any branch, not just the one where they were deposited.

The player's bank will start with 25 coins along with any Crown of Loyalty the player may be owed. Any items deposited into the bank on Tutorial Island are kept upon leaving the island (along with any items in the inventory, equipped, or in the metal bank).
Brace also briefly instructs players on general conduct in the RuneScape community.

p: Iroh is standing in front of the last building

steps.t: As long as the player is on Tutorial Island, they can switch freely between the four game modes. Once they leave the island, they can speak to Iroh on the Iron Enclave to switch further. However, Iroh will only let the Ironman Mode player switch to Group Ironman Mode.
Players who do not wish to leave quite yet may use the Escape key on their keyboard to dismiss the teleportation window.

The Home Teleport spell will teleport the player to Lumbridge, ending the tutorial mode. Moving on to the mainland will unlock access to the rest of the world of Gielinor, the ability to speak in chat, and the ability to further train skills. Players will arrive at the Lumbridge lodestone.
Any items acquired on Tutorial Island are kept upon leaving the island (including items in the backpack, equipped, in the bank, or in the metal bank). All items are converted to the tradable version.
